newsitem.title: USA: Darden corporate president, COO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Darden corporate president, COO resigns.

text.p: Darden Restaurants Inc said Friday that Corporate President and Chief Operating Officer Jeffrey O'Hara has resigned as part of the company's effort to restructure its operations.
O'Hara will continue to serve as a senior consultant and work with Chief Executive Joe Lee for an interim period, the company said.

Darden Restaurants, which is hoping to save $15 million to $20 million a year from its restructuring, said additionally that there is a national search to bring in a new Red Lobster president from outside the company to "bring a fresh perspective" to the business.
It said Brad Blum, president of the Olive Garden, and during the interim, the Red Lobster executive team will report directly to Lee.
